name: Creekside Campground
facilities: Private campground. Creek access, launching, rentals and shuttles are unverified.
description: HELD: private campground at 274 Creekside Rd, Powell, about 0.6 mi below Powell Bridge. Only a Census address point (interpolated along the road) places it, about 100 m from the creek at Eddy mile ~25.9. No published creek-access or launch terms; its listed website returned an empty page. Needs a campground coordinate and the operator's terms before import.

name: Big Rock Camp Grounds
ownership: Private (operated by Sugar Island Camp, per that operator's listing)
facilities: Private campground with day use, per the operator's listing. Launch and landing terms are unpublished.
description: Private campground on Big Sugar Creek Road, also called Big Rock Park, run by the operator of Sugar Island Camp. The owner confirmed this Google Maps pin on 2026-11-02 (plus code 8687JMCF+95). It sits 81 m from the creek at Eddy mile 38.97, about 1.5 mi above MDC Deep Ford Access. This row marks the campground, not a launch: no published terms let non-guests put in or take out here.

name: Deep Ford Access
facilities: Parking lot and a gravel launch ramp suitable for canoes or kayaks. No trailers. Camping is prohibited. Open 4 AM to 10 PM.
description: MDC access on Big Sugar Creek with a gravel canoe and kayak launch, about 3.6 river miles above the Little Sugar confluence at Pineville. Crag O' Lea low-water bridge is about 0.5 mi downstream.
road_access: In Pineville, take Big Sugar Creek Road east from the elementary school for 3.5 miles.
parking_info: Parking lot beside the launch; no trailers.

name: Ables Sugar Island Camp
facilities: Private campground with canoe and kayak rental, per directory listings.
description: HELD: family-run campground and canoe rental at 1354 Big Sugar Creek Rd, Pineville, beside a large gravel bar about 2 mi below Deep Ford. Only a Census address point (Eddy mile ~42.5) places it. A published landing for private boats would make Deep Ford to Sugar Island a single-river trip; confirm the terms and the landing spot with the operator (417-223-4410).
